The matcha bar

layered, whisked &Pretty in green.

Every matcha is built in layers: fruit or flavour at the bottom, cold milk in the middle, and bright whisked matcha poured over the top. Give it a stir and watch it swirl.

Swap in any milk: whole, oat, almond, soy, lactose-free, skim or half & half.See the full menu
